meta.title: European politics knowledge network, c. 1950-2026
meta.description: Key works and debates in European politics: theories of European integration (neofunctionalism, liberal intergovernmentalism, multilevel governance, postfunctionalism, new intergovernmentalism), EU institutions and legislative politics, the Court of Justice and legal integration, Europeanization and compliance, the democratic deficit and legitimacy, Euroscepticism and public opinion, politicization, European Parliament elections, EMU and the eurozone crisis, enlargement and conditionality, democratic backsliding and the rule of law, cleavages and party-system realignment, the populist radical right, welfare states and social Europe, migration and the asylum crisis, Brexit, EU foreign policy and normative power, the regulatory state and governance, and differentiated integration. Works shared with the other maps are imported from them; others are top-cited 2006-2026 articles selected via Crossref (European politics and political science journals) and anchoring books and classics. Direction: source (later or dependent work) -> target (earlier or anchoring work).

edge_types.builds_on: source extends or relies on target's argument or evidence
edge_types.challenges: source contests target's claim, mechanism or evidence
edge_types.qualifies: source adds a scope condition or moderating factor to target
edge_types.extends_to_new_case: source applies target's logic to a new population, period or domain
edge_types.synthesizes: source integrates target with other work
edge_types.mechanism_tested_by: source tests a mechanism implied by target

meta.verification: Repo works come from the user's Zotero library. Works imported from the other maps keep their verification. Crossref-selected works take title, authors, year, venue and DOI from Crossref records. Anchors are checked in Crossref separately; see each node's `verified` field. One-line claims for non-repo works are my summaries.
